name: Samaiden Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，Samaiden Group Berhad 与 Parkland Renewable Energy 签署谅解备忘录，计划在马来西亚半岛开发总装机容量最高达1,000 MWac的CRESS可再生能源项目；同时完成以4,550万令吉收购霹雳州Teluk Intan约185.57公顷租赁土地。另一方面，公司终止了与柬埔寨合作伙伴的两项谅解备忘录（涉及Royal Railway土地开发及生物质项目），因未在12个月内签订最终合约。
overview_en: In 2026, Samaiden Group Berhad entered into a memorandum of understanding with Parkland Renewable Energy to collaborate on renewable energy projects in Peninsular Malaysia under the Corporate Renewable Energy Supply Scheme (CRESS) with aggregate installed capacity of up to 1,000 MWac, and completed the acquisition of approximately 185.57 hectares of leasehold land in Teluk Intan, Perak for RM45.5 million.

segments.name: 太阳能光伏系统EPCC
segments.note: 今年与Parkland Renewable Energy签署谅解备忘录，计划在马来西亚半岛开发CRESS项目；同时终止了一项柬埔寨土地开发相关的谅解备忘录。
segments.note_en: During the year, entered into an MOU with Parkland Renewable Energy for CRESS projects in Peninsular Malaysia, and terminated an MOU related to land development in Cambodia.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与Parkland Renewable Energy签署谅解备忘录，计划在马来西亚半岛开发CRESS可再生能源项目，总装机容量最高达1,000 MWac。
actions.text_en: Entered into an MOU with Parkland Renewable Energy to collaborate on CRESS renewable energy projects in Peninsular Malaysia with aggregate installed capacity of up to 1,000 MWac.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 终止与Royal Group、Management Venture Asia及Panna Energy就Royal Railway土地开发项目签署的谅解备忘录，因12个月内未签订最终合约。
actions.text_en: Terminated the MOU with Royal Group, Management Venture Asia and Panna Energy for the development project on Royal Railway land as no definitive contract was entered into within twelve months.

segments.name: 生物质与沼气系统EPCC
segments.note: 今年终止了柬埔寨Kampong Seila沼气项目的谅解备忘录。
segments.note_en: During the year, terminated the MOU for the biogas project in Kampong Seila, Cambodia.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 终止与Mong Sotheary Trading、Management Venture Asia及Panna Energy就柬埔寨Kampong Seila沼气项目签署的谅解备忘录，因12个月内未签订最终合约。
actions.text_en: Terminated the MOU with Mong Sotheary Trading, Management Venture Asia and Panna Energy for the biogas project in Kampong Seila, Cambodia as no definitive contract was entered into within twelve months.

segments.name_en: Leasing and investment activities, and renewable energy cons
segments.note: 今年完成收购霹雳州Teluk Intan约185.57公顷租赁土地。
segments.note_en: During the year, completed the acquisition of approximately 185.57 hectares of leasehold land in Teluk Intan, Perak.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以4,550万令吉现金完成收购霹雳州Teluk Intan两幅合计约185.57公顷的99年租赁土地。
actions.text_en: Completed the acquisition of two parcels of 99-year leasehold land in Teluk Intan, Perak measuring approximately 185.57 hectares in aggregate for a total cash consideration of RM45.5 million.

model_changes.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
model_changes.text: 终止柬埔寨Royal Railway土地开发项目的谅解备忘录，退出该合作项目。
model_changes.text_en: Terminated the MOU for the Royal Railway land development project in Cambodia, exiting the collaboration.
